jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Inferact's mission is to grow vLLM as the world's AI inference engine and accelerate AI progress by making inference cheaper and faster. Founded by the creators and core maintainers of vLLM, we sit at the intersection of models and hardware, a position that took years to build.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to accelerate vLLM’s position as the leading open-source inference engine and publicize Inferact’s role in driving its development. This role sits at the intersection of product marketing, events, partner marketing, community, and growth. You’ll help turn a high volume of conference and ecosystem demand into a proactive GTM motion that builds brand awareness, community engagement, and qualified momentum around vLLM and Inferact



You’ll own end-to-end execution for conferences, partner events, hosted events, landing pages, speaker coordination, booth needs, collateral, follow-up workflows, and the many details that make technical events successful. You’ll develop and strengthen relationships between Inferact and major corporate and ecosystem partners, while shaping the messaging and presence of both vLLM and Inferact, while developing . You’ll work closely with product, engineering, leadership, partners, and design collaborators. This is a hands-on 0-to-1 role for someone with strong taste, high urgency, and an AI-native way of working.

Skills and Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in marketing, product, computer science, business, communications, or a related field.

 - Strong product marketing or GTM fundamentals, including positioning, messaging, audience definition, narrative development, and practical execution.

 - AI-native operating style, with regular use of modern AI tools to accelerate writing, research, planning, landing pages, workflows, asset drafts, and execution.

 - Experience owning events, conferences, partner activations, launches, or community programs end-to-end, including logistics, timelines, vendors, speakers, assets, landing pages, and follow-up.

 - Strong taste and judgment around brand, tone of voice, event experience, marketing quality, and developer-facing credibility.

 - Ability to operate autonomously in a startup environment, proactively recommend what should happen next, and execute without needing every step prescribed.

 - Ability to work credibly with product, engineering, founders, partners, design agencies, and technical communities.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience marketing to developers, infrastructure engineers, ML engineers, technical founders, open-source communities, or AI / developer tools audiences.

 - Experience with AI infrastructure, developer tools, model serving, cloud platforms, open-source infrastructure, or other technical products.

 - Experience running partner marketing or co-marketing programs with ecosystem partners such as cloud providers, hardware companies, infrastructure platforms, or developer communities.

 - Ability to personally create or coordinate landing pages, event pages, simple websites, forms, briefs, and campaign assets using AI, no-code tools, or lightweight technical workflows.

 - Experience building 0-to-1 marketing programs, event playbooks, launch motions, or community programs in a startup or high-ambiguity environment.

Bonus points if you have:

 - Built an event or community strategy that materially improved brand awareness, partner momentum, developer mindshare, or qualified pipeline.

 - Worked in or around AI infrastructure, open-source infrastructure, developer tools, data infrastructure, cloud, GPU, or technical SaaS ecosystems.

 - Created high-quality technical marketing assets, launch narratives, event experiences, partner campaigns, or developer-facing content that you can walk through in detail.

 - Partnered with design agencies or external creative teams while maintaining speed, quality, and brand consistency.

 - Helped a startup move from reactive marketing execution to a proactive 6-12 month GTM, events, or community plan.

Logistics

 - Location: This role is based in San Francisco, California. Will consider remote in the US for exceptional candidates.

 - Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas on a case-by-case basis.

 - Benefits: Inferact offers generous health, dental, and vision benefits as well as 401(k) company match.

jobs.title: Technical Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Inferact's mission is to grow vLLM as the world's AI inference engine and accelerate AI progress by making inference cheaper and faster. Founded by the creators and core maintainers of vLLM, we sit at the intersection of models and hardware, a position that took years to build.



About the Role

We're looking for a Technical Product Marketing Manager to own product marketing for vLLM and Inferact across launches, positioning, technical narratives, partner announcements, and sales enablement.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can translate complex AI infrastructure into credible developer-facing messaging, work directly with engineers and ecosystem partners, and build repeatable launch systems that scale. You will own day-0 launch communications, product positioning, the benchmark narrative, customer proof, and the forward product marketing roadmap.

 
 

30-60-90 Day Milestones

30 Days: Outside Counsel Alignment & Contracting Intake

 - Become the single owner for launch communications across vLLM and Inferact, including blog, social copy, partner coordination, and the internal readiness checklist.

 - Ship at least two launches as primary author and publish a launch playbook that engineers and partners can follow without additional direction.

 - Build a competitive teardown of recent launches and use it to establish the quality bar for future launches.

60 Days: Frontier AI & Regulatory Strategy

 - Own positioning and messaging, including personas, competitive talk tracks, and website product pages.

 - Own partnership announcements with ecosystem partners such as Google, AMD, and NVIDIA from messaging through launch day.

 - Own the sales collateral kit and standard vLLM plus Inferact talk template, and run enablement for engineers presenting externally.

 - Own product messaging across vLLM and Inferact, including technical product breakdowns, benefits, customer case studies, and supporting GTM materials in close partnership with GTM teams.

90 Days: Scalable Legal Infrastructure

 - Present a 2027 product marketing plan covering launch tiers, the benchmark program, case study pipeline, and partner relationships.

 - Bring market and customer input into the product roadmap and pricing and packaging discussions.

 - Create a structured feedback loop between Marketing and Sales with Product and Engineering, ensuring customer, market, and GTM feedback consistently flows into product and launch decisions.

 - Build and operationalize a repeatable marketing process for launching vLLM and Inferact content, covering intake, messaging, review, distribution, partner amplification, and post-launch measurement.



Skills and Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience as an engineer or developer.

 - Experience owning product marketing or developer relations for open-source software, LLM infrastructure, AI infrastructure, or developer tools.

 - Strong product marketing fundamentals across positioning, messaging, audience definition, narrative development, launches, and practical GTM execution.

 - Ability to write and edit technical launch content that is credible with developers, ML engineers, and infrastructure engineers.

 - Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product, leadership, design, sales, and external partners.

 - Hands-on execution mindset with the ability to build launch systems, templates, and playbooks in a fast-moving startup environment.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Deep familiarity with AI infrastructure, model serving, vLLM, open-source infrastructure, cloud platforms, or GPU ecosystems.

 - Experience owning benchmark narratives, technical product pages, customer case studies, or developer-facing sales enablement.

 - Experience leading joint GTM with cloud providers, hardware vendors, model companies, or open-source ecosystem partners.

 - Track record building product marketing programs from 0 to 1 and turning reactive launch work into a proactive roadmap.

Bonus points if you have:

 - Direct experience marketing inference, model serving, or other performance-sensitive AI infrastructure.

 - Experience launching open-source projects or commercial products built around an open-source ecosystem.

 - Ability to create lightweight technical assets, landing pages, demos, or workflows using modern AI and no-code tools.



Logistics

 - Location: San Francisco, CA (On-site)

 - Compensation: Compensation determined based on background, skills, and experience. Offers include competitive base salary & meaningful equity.

 - Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas on a case-by-case basis.

 - Benefits: Inferact offers generous health, dental, and vision benefits as well as 401(k) company match.
